title: Reuse a hosted projection
responsibility: Read a validated cached projection or load, validate and cache a replacement.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.context
inputs.description: Source context whose identity fields are spread into the cache identity (the function then sets artifactHash to null and profile to 'projection:' plus a hash of the profile name) and whose cache store is used for reads, writes and deleting unusable entries. The caller must resolve current GitHub refs and permissions before consulting this cache, and this function performs no such check.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.projection
inputs.description: The profile string is UTF-8 encoded and hashed into the cache identity, so each profile name maps to its own cache identity. The accept callback receives either the parsed cached JSON or a freshly loaded value and returns the value to use; a throw from it on cached data deletes that entry and triggers a reload, while a throw on fresh data propagates unchanged.

inputs.name: hubProjectionCache.load
inputs.description: Asynchronous loader that runs only when readCache returns a falsy value or the cached bytes fail UTF-8 decoding, JSON.parse or accept. Its resolved value is passed through accept and then cached, while a rejection propagates to the caller and nothing is written to the cache.

outputs.name: hubProjectionCache
outputs.description: Resolves to the accept result for a usable cache entry, or to the accept result for a fresh load that is written to the cache before the promise resolves. Because fresh values are JSON-serialized before storage, T must be JSON-serializable, and an unusable cached entry is deleted before loading.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.stringify when the accepted fresh value cannot be serialized, such as a BigInt or a circular reference. It is raised after load and accept succeed and before writeCache runs, so nothing is stored.

errors.name: load() rejection
errors.description: Any rejection from load() propagates unchanged and nothing is written to the cache. An unusable cache entry has already been deleted by the time load() runs.

errors.name: projection.accept throw
errors.description: A throw from accept on a freshly loaded value propagates unchanged and nothing is cached. A throw from accept on a cached value is swallowed: the entry is deleted and load() runs instead.

errors.name: cache or hubHash rejection
errors.description: Rejections from hubHash, readCache, writeCache, cacheKey and context.cache.delete propagate unchanged, since none of these calls is wrapped in the try block.
